source: The important point is what a miss means. If L1 cannot supply the requested sector, the request consumes capacity and bandwidth farther downstream. If L2 also misses, device memory must provide the data. A cache hit therefore saves downstream traffic and usually avoids some of the delay associated with going farther out.
zh: 重要的一点是失误意味着什么。如果 L1 无法提供所请求的扇区，则该请求会消耗下游的容量和带宽。如果 L2 也未命中，设备内存必须提供数据。因此，缓存命中可以节省下游流量，并且通常可以避免与更远的传输相关的一些延迟。
